snippet.title: IRON NEST Release Date Announcement | August 6, 2026
snippet.description:
⚠️ 𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐘 𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐎 & 𝐖𝐈𝐒𝐇𝐋𝐈𝐒𝐓 𝐍𝐎𝐖 𝐎𝐍 𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐌 ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950790/IRON_NEST_Heavy_Turret_Simulator/
🎯 𝐑𝐄𝐏𝐎𝐑𝐓 𝐓𝐎 𝐃𝐈𝐒𝐂𝐎𝐑𝐃 ► https://discord.gg/ironnestgame

=======// 𝘈𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘎𝘢𝘮𝘦 //=======

IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery simulator where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Every lever, every dial, and every shot is under your control. High Command may send its orders, but the chain of command ends at your fingertips. They don't carry consequences. You do, Operator. 

𝐌𝐀𝐊𝐄 𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐑𝐘 𝐒𝐇𝐎𝐓 𝐂𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐓

=======// 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘖𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘯𝘴𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘗𝘭𝘢𝘯 //=======

✅ 𝐈𝐍𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐘𝐓𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐒 ➙ Live on Discord (will continue until release)
❎ 𝐈𝐍𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐎 ➙ NEST FEST (Feb 23 ➙ Mar 2, 2026)
✅ 𝐏𝐔𝐁𝐋𝐈𝐂 𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐎 & 𝐑𝐄𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐒𝐄 𝐃𝐀𝐓𝐄 𝐑𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐀𝐋 ➙ June 15, 2026 during Steam Next Fest 
⛔️ 𝐅𝐔𝐋𝐋 𝐆𝐀𝐌𝐄 ➙ August 6, 2026

=======// 𝘈𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘛𝘦𝘢𝘮 //=======

IRON NEST is a two-man operation run by its co-founders: Nick Talmers, stationed in Spain, and Dominik Latos, stationed in Poland. The project is fully self-published. No publisher, no outside investors, and no third parties pulling the strings. The division of duties is clear. Nick is the sole developer, building IRON NEST from the ground up. Dominik commands the entire propaganda efforts to mobilize new Operators and expand the NEST’s reach. Together, Nick and Dominik bring 25+ years of industry experience. This alliance was sealed at gamescom, fueled by alcohol and questionable decisions… just like any proper field operation.

=======// 𝘚𝘰𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘔𝘦𝘥𝘪𝘢 //=======

🟩 Linktr.ee ➙ https://linktr.ee/IRONNEST
🟪 Discord ➙ https://discord.gg/ironnestgame
⬜️ Patreon ➙ https://www.patreon.com/cw/IRONNESTgame

=======// 𝘏𝘢𝘴𝘩𝘵𝘢𝘨𝘴 //=======

#IRONNEST #IndieGame #HeavyArtillerySimulator #Simulator #Dieselpunk #PCGame

=======// 𝘈𝘤𝘬𝘯𝘰𝘸𝘭𝘦𝘥𝘨𝘦𝘮𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘴 //=======

Thank you to everyone who has stood with us from the very beginning of this journey. It is hard to believe that after all these months, release is now just around the corner. None of this would have been possible without you.

𝐆𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐘 𝐓𝐎 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒!
𝐆𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐘 𝐓𝐎 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐎𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒!
𝐆𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐘 𝐓𝐎 𝐓𝐇...

Nick & Dominik
